   242→    const cacheEntries: Array<{ key: string; timestamp: number }> = []

   339→      removeFromQueue(currentOutfitIdRef.current)
   340→
   341→      // Check new outfit's cache
   342→      const cached = getCachedImage(outfitId)
   343→      if (cached) {
   344→        setFlatLayImageBase64(cached)
   345→        setIsFromCache(true)
   346→        hasAttemptedRef.current = true
   347→      } else {
   348→        setFlatLayImageBase64(undefined)
   349→        setIsFromCache(false)
   350→        hasAttemptedRef.current = false
   351→      }
   352→
   353→      setIsGenerating(false)
   354→      setIsQueued(false)
   355→      setQueuePosition(0)
   356→      setError(undefined)
   357→      currentOutfitIdRef.current = outfitId
   358→    }
   359→  }, [outfitId])
   360→
   361→  // Update queue position periodically when queued
   362→  useEffect(() => {
   363→    if (!isQueued) return
   364→
   365→    const interval = setInterval(() => {
   366→      const pos = getQueuePosition(outfitId)
   367→      if (isMountedRef.current) {
   368→        setQueuePosition(pos)
   369→        if (pos === 0) {
   370→          // No longer in queue, stop checking
   371→          setIsQueued(false)
   372→        }
   373→      }
   374→    }, 500)
   375→
   376→    return () => clearInterval(interval)
   377→  }, [isQueued, outfitId])
   378→
   379→  // Cleanup on unmount
   380→  useEffect(() => {
   381→    isMountedRef.current = true
   382→    return () => {

   392→  const performGeneration = useCallback(async () => {
   393→    if (!isMountedRef.current) return

   397→    setQueuePosition(0)
   398→    setIsGenerating(true)
   399→    setError(undefined)
   400→    hasAttemptedRef.current = true

   402→
   403→    const flatLayItems = transformToFlatLayItems(items)
   404→

   406→    const maxRetries = 1

   411→        if (attempt > 0) {

   413→          const delay = Math.pow(2, attempt) * 1000
   414→          await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, delay))
   415→        }

   418→          method: 'POST',
   419→          headers: {

   421→          },
   422→          body: JSON.stringify({

   434→          return

   445→          processQueue() // Process next in queue
   446→          return
   447→        } else {

   461→    currentGenerations--
   462→    processQueue() // Process next in queue even on failure
   463→  }, [outfitId, items, occasionContext])
   464→

   494→      return
   495→    }
   496→

   508→    isFromCache,

   515→export function useIntersectionObserver(
   516→  callback: () => void,
   517→  options?: IntersectionObserverInit
   518→): React.RefCallback<HTMLElement> {
   519→  const observerRef = useRef<IntersectionObserver | null>(null)
   520→  const hasTriggeredRef = useRef(false)
   521→
   522→  const setRef = useCallback(
   523→    (element: HTMLElement | null) => {
   524→      // Disconnect previous observer
   525→      if (observerRef.current) {
   526→        observerRef.current.disconnect()
   527→        observerRef.current = null
   528→      }
   529→
   530→      // Skip if already triggered or no element
   531→      if (hasTriggeredRef.current || !element) {
   532→        return
   533→      }
   534→
   535→      observerRef.current = new IntersectionObserver(
   536→        (entries) => {
   537→          const [entry] = entries
   538→          if (entry?.isIntersecting && !hasTriggeredRef.current) {
   539→            hasTriggeredRef.current = true
   540→            callback()
   541→            // Disconnect after triggering
   542→            observerRef.current?.disconnect()
   543→          }
   544→        },
   545→        {
   546→          threshold: 0.1, // Trigger when 10% visible
   547→          ...options,
   548→        }
   549→      )
   550→
   551→      observerRef.current.observe(element)
   552→    },
   553→    [callback, options]
   554→  )
   555→
   556→  // Cleanup on unmount
   557→  useEffect(() => {
   558→    return () => {
   559→      observerRef.current?.disconnect()
   560→    }
   561→  }, [])
   562→
   563→  return setRef
   564→}

   293→/**

   297→export function deduplicateOutfitCategories(
   298→  items: Product[],

   315→
   316→  // For each category, keep only the best-scoring item

   318→
   319→  for (const [category, products] of Array.from(categoryMap.entries())) {
   320→    if (products.length === 1) {
